
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qq2806933146xiaobai/p/21801483" title="发布于 2026-07-22 23:23">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">详细pyenv+venv+pip安装ultralytics</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">一、用pyenv管理python版本</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">  ‌pyenv‌：第三方版本管理器，‌只管理Python解释器版本‌，能在一台机器上安装切换多个Python版本（如3.8、3.10、3.11），不修改系统原生Python。</span></p>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">1、安装pyenv</span></h4>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pyenv-win/pyenv-win/master/pyenv-win/install-pyenv-win.ps1" -OutFile "./install-pyenv-win.ps1"; &amp;"./install-pyenv-win.ps1"</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231605855-1757356988.png" alt="image" height="488" width="576"></span></p>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">2、安装python</span></h4>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>pyenv install 3.10.11
pyenv global 3.10.11
python --version
#pyenv versions  # 查看本机所有已安装Python版本</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231648700-1470224632.png" alt="image" height="488" width="577">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h3><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">二、用pyenv隔离ultralytics运行环境</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">  ‌venv‌：Python 3.3+ 内置的虚拟环境工具，‌只隔离依赖包‌，同一个Python版本下不同项目可以用venv互不干扰地安装不同版本的包。</span></p>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">1、创建yolo的虚拟运行环境</span></h4>
<h5><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">(1)创建虚拟环境</span></h5>
<p><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">  先下载ultralytics项目，如：D:\VS\Test2\ultralytics</span></p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code># 进入项目目录
cd D:\VS\Test2\ultralytics
# 锁定项目用的python版本
pyenv local 3.10.11
# 创建项目专属虚拟环境 同：python -m virtualenv D:\VS\Test2\ultralytics\.venv
python -m venv .venv
# 激活虚拟环境
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231731742-1955430087.png" alt="image"></span></p>
<h5><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">(2)安装项目依赖</span></h5>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code># 安装 setuptools 和 wheel；同：D:\VS\Test2\ultralytics\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install setuptools==82.0.1 wheel -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install setuptools==82.0.1 wheel -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
# 安装 ultralytics（可编辑模式） 代替pip install -U ultralytics
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e . --no-build-isolation -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
# 验证yolo依赖是否安装成功
yolo --version</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231756881-2099859710.png" alt="image" height="279" width="881"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231821590-823400341.png" alt="image" height="64" width="637"></span></p>
<h5><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">(3)设置配置目录</span></h5>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>$env:YOLO_CONFIG_DIR="D:\VS\Test2\ultralytics\.ultralytics"</code></pre>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">2、测试用yolo26n.pt进行检测</span></h4>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>.venv\Scripts\yolo predict model=yolo26n.pt &nbsp;# 未下载的会重新下载</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231856522-2138790672.png" alt="image" height="499" width="881"></span></p>
<h3><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">三、Onnx模型</span></h3>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">1、导出Onnx模型</span></h4>
<h5><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">(1)安装依赖</span></h5>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install "onnx&gt;=1.12.0,&lt;2.0.0" onnxruntime "onnxslim&gt;=0.1.82" -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</code></pre>
<h5><span style="font-size: 13px; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">(2)执行导出</span></h5>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>.venv\Scripts\yolo export model=yolo26n.pt format=onnx</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722231950999-77194948.png" alt="image" height="787" width="881"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722232045490-880282836.png" alt="image" height="244" width="883"></span></p>
<h4><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">2、测试Onnx模型</span></h4>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>.venv\Scripts\yolo predict task=detect model=yolo26n.onnx imgsz=640
.venv\Scripts\yolo predict task=detect model=yolo26l.onnx imgsz=640
.venv\Scripts\yolo predict task=detect model=yolo11s.onnx imgsz=640</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1570874/202607/1570874-20260722232110962-1774445678.png" alt="image" height="184" width="765">、</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, 宋体">  可以看出，Onnx正常导出。</span></p>
